fact: The Direction générale des Élections presented the definitive figures of the permanent biometric electoral file, 6,768,458 voters including those abroad.
The DGE and ONECI signed a convention on 22 January 2026 to strengthen the reliability of the existing biometric electoral file (fichier électoral biométrique), per Mediaguinee.

The convention makes the data of the registre national des personnes physiques the single official source of voter identification data for the biometric electoral lists, says the DGE director general.
The MATD minister lists among 2025 achievements the putting in place of the biometric electoral file, while saying finalisation of the electoral process still needs funding.

Jurist Sayon Mara writes that the first phase of PN-RAVEC, launched 15 April 2025 with biometric enrolment of people aged 10 and over, consists essentially of building the RNPP in order to extract the electoral file for the referendum and national and local elections.
